scope.limitation: This is a specification, not an executable benchmark runner. Proposed task fixtures must be built and frozen before model runs. Offline host observations live in the separate probe JSON.

smoke.purpose: Detect contract failures, not establish superiority

design.comparison: paired by task; randomized interleaving; one variable at a time; analyze each task family
design.coldWarmAssignment: Separate controlled cohorts and report actual provider cache usage; elapsed time or flags alone do not prove cache state.

runBudget.note: Unset; must be explicitly configured before model execution. This file does not initiate paid runs.

qualityGate.statisticalUnit: task; cluster repeated runs within task
qualityGate.method: pre-register paired cluster confidence intervals; retain baseline when intervals do not support noninferiority
qualityGate.note: Engineering choice, not a proven statistical power calculation. Small smoke/holdout samples may remain inconclusive.

metrics.totalTokens: Sum input_tokens + output_tokens for all requests; never add reasoning again when already included in output.
metrics.cost: Sum all attempts including failed main/child/summary/optimizer/judge calls plus tool/compute costs; do not double-count subledgers.
metrics.missingUsage: Keep null/unknown, report coverage; never convert unreported cache fields to zero.
metrics.zeroAccepted: Cost per accepted task is undefined/infinite, never zero.
metrics.successComparison: Same completed acceptance scope; exclude no failures from totals.

officialPriceSnapshot.limitation: Official snapshot only; not a third-party gateway price or guarantee.

experiments.label: stream-contract
experiments.description: Synthetic streams: final content+usage, usage-only, missing usage, explicit zero, interrupted stream; per-provider fixture, never an HTTP model call.

experiments.label: completion-contract
experiments.description: Separate ordinary visible stop, legitimate control-only response, reasoning-only no-result, tool output completion and max-token truncation; preserve existing no-forced-output behavior.

experiments.label: context-contract
experiments.description: Synthetic pre-step compaction and max-tokens continuation must consume current state; preserve reasoning and tool call/result pairing.

experiments.label: effort
experiments.description: Baseline high; compare max on hard tasks and low/none only on mechanical tasks in separate trials. Do not change output cap at the same time.

experiments.label: final-answer
experiments.description: Baseline vs concise final answer only, preserving artifacts, evidence and material limitations; no additional CoD instruction.

experiments.label: observation
experiments.description: Baseline result vs task-focused bounded preview and retrievable full artifact. Include middle-evidence traps and errors.

experiments.label: ptc
experiments.description: Existing PTC baseline vs persistent state, same tool surface and permission contract. Test direct-tool vs PTC separately, not in same comparison.

experiments.label: history
experiments.description: Current strategy vs bounded observation masking or hybrid phase summary, one candidate at a time; include summary cost, rereads and cache reconstruction.

experiments.label: memory
experiments.description: No memory vs verified retrieved entries from a training split; held-out task facts and answers must not leak.

experiments.label: task-capsule
experiments.description: Original request vs structured goal/facts/scope/constraints/acceptance/delivery, with human or deterministic semantic-equivalence check.

experiments.label: prompt-repeat
experiments.description: One copy vs two copies for short non-thinking classification/extraction only; count increased input and all output.

experiments.label: short-draft
experiments.description: Baseline vs short draft on isolated short reasoning cases. Do not enforce tiny output cap; reject accuracy loss.

experiments.label: prompt-ablation
experiments.description: Remove only irrelevant/conflicting role text; keep task, tools, protocol and permissions identical. Never select samples by reasoning wording.

experiments.label: vision
experiments.description: Original vs moderate resize vs relevant crop in separate arms; retain same question, verify small text and whole-page relations, sum all image costs.

experiments.label: agents
experiments.description: Single-agent baseline vs bounded independent subtask delegation; include spawn overhead, child requests, failed children, merge and review.

experiments.label: prompt-search
experiments.description: GEPA-style narrow search with fixed weights; separate train/validation/held-out task families. Include optimizer/reflector/judge costs and amortization.
